data_fields.name: max_stack_quantity
data_fields.donor_constant: quantity type limit (donor type not read)

best_idea: A pickup or move is one function that tries to merge into an existing stack first, checks capacity only for the pool that is capped, writes the destination, and shrinks the source only after the destination accepted.
decision_why: Keep the stack rule (kind, no-merge flags and identified state; overflow checked on the whole floor stack), merge-before-capacity and source decrement after acceptance; drop the keyboard letter scheme because a phone grid assigns slots by position, not by letter.
acceptance: A player picks up 2 of 5 potions while carrying 3 of the same potion: the bag shows 5 in one cell, the floor pile shows 3, and the toast reads gained 2. With a full gear bag and a new sword on the floor, the sword stays on the floor and the bag is unchanged; a server test asserts that a rejected pickup leaves both the bag quantity and the floor quantity exactly as they were.
